definitions: A building equipped with machinery for grinding grain into flour.
A factory for processing raw materials, such as cotton, steel, or paper.
A small, hand-operated device for grinding or crushing a substance, such as a pepper mill.
A machine that grinds, cuts, or shapes material, especially metal.
A common unit of currency in the United States, equal to one thousandth of a dollar, used especially in calculating property taxes.
examples: The old mill stands by the river.
The steel mill closed last year.
She used a coffee mill to grind the beans.
The engineer operated the milling machine.
The tax rate was set at 20 mills.
